title: Government-published propaganda books as a cover-up campaign
summary: Brent Friedman tells of Government-published propaganda books as a cover-up campaign, about 1981 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and you're going to find all sorts of books on the shelves with lots of truth. But right next to them are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.

plain: Brent Friedman, a guest on a podcast, retells what he says John Harrington, presented as a former US Secretary of Energy, told him around 1981. According to Friedman, Harrington said bookstore shelves hold many books with lots of truth about UFOs, but right next to them are books the government publishes full of propaganda. He called it a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.
